name: io.github.jordanmrash/aor-batch-exec
title: Agent of Record: approved batch executor
description: Runs one existing person-approved script by relative name under one folder. No command or arguments.

environmentVariables.name: COWORK_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The one folder the executor is confined to: scripts under <root>/CommandJobs, deliverables under <root>/Outputs.

environmentVariables.name: COWORK_CONFIG_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional folder holding cowork-memory/cowork-lessons.md for the operating-rules reminder.
